Embedding request via Google Vertex AI using the vertex_ai/ provider prefix and the text-embedding-005 model — response follows the standard OpenAI embeddings shape

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"Hello\",\"model\":\"vertex_ai/text-embedding-005\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.embed(_req)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].embedding)
```
